sources.entry: ⭐️ System design interview for IT company

summary.one_liner: A reading-list and study guide for preparing system design and object-oriented design interviews at tech companies, consisting mostly of links to articles, papers, and books.
summary.what_it_does: The README gives a short framework for system design interviews: clarify requirements and scale, sketch high-level architecture, then detail components with APIs and schemas. It also covers an object-oriented design approach (use cases, identifying classes, relationships, and attributes). The bulk of the content is curated links organized into sections: basic system design articles, company engineering blogs, papers and architecture write-ups for real products and systems, and per-question reference lists (for example CDN design, URL shortener, news feed, top-k, and web crawler). It also lists a few recommended books and one OOD tips link.
use_cases: Preparing for a system design interview
Studying how large-scale products are architected
Finding reference articles for designing a URL shortener or CDN
Reading company engineering blogs before an onsite
notable: Per-question reference lists for common interview prompts such as news feed, top-k, and trending topics
Curated links to engineering blogs from many companies
Covers both system design and object-oriented design interview approaches
caveats: Content is a collection of links and short notes, not a runnable project or code
Many linked resources are older articles and may be dated
Table of contents has unchecked items, suggesting the guide is incomplete
